description: ATProto handle-to-DID resolution conformance vectors for packages/shared/src/handles/atproto.ts. Resolution is DNS TXT `_atproto.<handle>` first, then an HTTPS well-known fallback. IO is injected; invalid handles must be rejected before either boundary is reached.

invalid.name: http-endpoint-rejected
invalid.reason: The DNS value is an HTTP endpoint, not an allowed did:plc/did:web identifier. It must fail closed and must never be treated as a fetch target.

invalid.name: userinfo-host-injection
invalid.reason: An at-sign inside the hostname could become URL userinfo if interpolated before validation. Reject it before any DNS or HTTPS IO.

invalid.name: all-numeric-tld
invalid.reason: ATProto handles follow the domain grammar but additionally forbid an all-numeric final label.
